{{Top|leg}}
The '''string oscillator''' was a [[Music/Legends|musical]] instrument. The [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] [[Neena]] was a practitioner of the string oscillator.

==Behind the scenes==
While Neena's biography does not mention with what musical instrument she demonstrated talent, her game statistics in [[Galaxy Guide 6: Tramp Freighters (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 6: Tramp Freighters'', Second Edition]] includes a skill specialization naming this instrument.
